name: Praia
subtitle: Praia, capital of Cabo Verde: its numbers, a short history and places to see beyond the World Heritage list.

keyPoints.text: Praia, the capital of the Republic of Cabo Verde, lies on the southern coast of Santiago, the largest island of the archipelago.
The city sits on a plateau with a central square, around which stand its main institutions such as churches, courts, town hall, market, banks and hospitals.

parts.text: Praia, the capital of the Republic of Cabo Verde, lies on the southern coast of Santiago, the largest island of the archipelago.
The city sits on a plateau with a central square, around which stand its main institutions such as churches, courts, town hall, market, banks and hospitals.
The town of Praia de Santa Maria appeared in 1615, when settlement began on a plateau near a beach that the colonisers called Santa Maria.
After national independence in 1975 Praia experienced a demographic explosion caused by strong migration from the other islands and municipalities.
The municipal territory of Praia covers 258.1 km2.
Praia hosts the country's main industries and most of its services.
Praia airport was the first airport built and certified after independence.
In 2005 two of the three parishes of the municipality, its rural area, became a new municipality, Ribeira Grande de Santiago.
The Sucupira and Plateau markets are the capital's main markets, around which many informal street vendors work.

blocks.prompt: About how many people do you think live in Praia?

parts.text: 131,602 in 2010, according to the figures compiled from the national statistics office. Which area is counted matters: Praia, the capital city and seat of the municipality of the same name, as given by the UN-Habitat urban profile citing the 2010 census; the same document elsewhere gives 131,719 for the municipal area of 258.1 km2.

items.text: The port of Praia is the place where enslaved Africans were landed from 1515, according to a study of the city's urban history.
The town of Praia de Santa Maria arose when settlement of the plateau began.
The official transfer of the capital from Ribeira Grande to Praia de Santa Maria took place.
A decree raised Praia from town to city and made it definitively the capital of Cabo Verde.
After independence the city of Praia came to be understood as the Plateau plus all the surrounding neighbourhoods.
Part of Praia's rural area became the new municipality of Ribeira Grande de Santiago.

blocks.q: Myth or fact: Praia has always been the capital of Cabo Verde.
blocks.explain: The capital was Ribeira Grande (today Cidade Velha) until the official transfer to Praia de Santa Maria in 1770; a decree of 1858 then made Praia a city and definitively the capital.
